RESPONSIBLE STATECRAFT: Is Trump finally burying the zombie US-Mexico-Canada trade pact?
June 11, 2026 | 🟢

Karthik Sankaran reads the USMCA collapse as Trump squeezing Canada while Mexico actually comes out ahead — and names a "CIA operation in an opposition-led state" as US interference in Mexican politics, a line most US outlets won't print.

The trade-war engine still runs on the same Mexican low-wage labor Trump claims to be insulating against.

• "Trump has interfered to some extent in Mexican politics"
• "most recently through a CIA operation in an opposition-led state"
• "going to be talking about rules of origin in a way that enhances U.S. content"
• "the American private sector's need for a lower-wage production base"

FOX/OUTKICK: Anti-government protesters clash with riot police outside World Cup opener while Shakira performs inside
June 11, 2026 | 🔴

Fox/OutKick covers Mexico's World Cup opener as a pop-star-vs-mob spectacle — "violence erupted," "riot police deploy batons," "a man reportedly suffered a heart attack." Zero quotes from a single protester, teacher, or mother of the disappeared.

The 130,000 missing and the 2007 ISSSTE pension privatization the CNTE is fighting to reverse get one line between them — context as scenery.

• "Violence erupted outside the 2026 World Cup opening ceremony"
• "Demonstrators raised concerns about cartel violence and poverty"
• "a man reportedly suffered a heart attack"
• "roughly 130,000 people reported missing across the country"

🇲🇽🏭 <u>INDUSTRIAL ACTIVITY SURGES 1.8% — BEST GROWTH IN 2.5 YEARS</u>

INEGI data out today: Mexico's industrial production grew 1.8% annually in April, the strongest since November 2023. Monthly growth hit 2.1% — highest since March 2021.

Construction exploded 7.6% in a single month. Manufacturing added 1.2%.

While the stagnation narrative was making rounds in financial press, actual INEGI data was quietly breaking the pattern.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>LAZZERI CONFIRMED AS MEXICO'S AMBASSADOR TO WASHINGTON — 27 TO 8</u>

The Permanent Commission ratified Roberto Lazzeri as Mexico's ambassador to the US. PRI and PAN voted against, claiming he "lacks diplomatic experience" — the same parties that sent politicians like Ramírez Acuña and Beatriz Paredes to the embassy.

Lazzeri ran Nafin and Bancomext. He called the T-MEC "steroids for Plan México" and pledged to maintain "congruence between external negotiation and sovereign industrial policy."

An economist defending Mexico's economic sovereignty in Washington. That's the mandate.

🇲🇽🏫 <u>SHEINBAUM BYPASSES UNION BOSSES — GOES DIRECTLY TO TEACHERS ON SCRAPPING PEÑA NIETO'S USICAMM</u>

Instead of repressing or caving, Sheinbaum chose direct democracy. In August, the government will launch a school-by-school consultation asking rank-and-file teachers whether to eliminate Usicamm — the punitive evaluation system from Peña Nieto's 2013 reform.

No intermediaries. No union bosses deciding for over a million teachers.

"We're not going to ask the union leadership — we'll go directly to teachers. Mexico is a democratic country, we don't repress."

A peer-evaluation model based on UNAM's system is proposed as replacement.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>EDUCATION SECRETARY CALLS OUT POLITICAL MANIPULATION BEHIND WORLD CUP PROTESTS</u>

"It's political interest that drives them now, trying to affect the World Cup" — Education Secretary Mario Delgado, naming what everyone could see.

The federal government invested over 23 billion pesos in Oaxaca education infrastructure alone, maintained permanent dialogue tables in four states, offered concrete solutions. The CNTE leadership still timed their march to the World Cup inauguration at Estadio Azteca.

Dialogue was offered. Demands were addressed. The timing told the whole story.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>MEXICAN TAX OFFICIAL FORCED OUT AFTER $20K NBA SEATS NEAR TRUMP'S BOX</u>

Héctor Contreras, head of Quintana Roo's state tax administration, resigned after being photographed at the NBA Finals in Madison Square Garden — in the VIP zone directly below Donald Trump's box. Seats in that section: up to 350,000 pesos ($20,000 USD).

Under the 4T's austerity standards, flaunting that kind of wealth while collecting taxes from ordinary Mexicans is a career-ender. In the US, officials sit courtside with billionaires and nobody blinks.

🚨🌎 <u>TRUMP'S WARS CRASH GLOBAL GROWTH TO PANDEMIC LOWS — WORLD BANK</u>

The World Bank cut its 2026 global growth forecast to 2.5% — the lowest since COVID — driven by the US-Israel war on Iran, the Hormuz closure, and oil surging 36% to $94/barrel.

Two-thirds of world economies downgraded since January. Developing nations hit hardest at 3.6%, a post-pandemic floor. Worst case: global growth collapses to 1.3%.

"Protect people and preserve stability today, without giving up on growth and jobs tomorrow" — World Bank President Ajay Banga.

The empire wages war. The world pays the bill.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>CHINA EXPORTS UP 19.4% IN MAY — TRUMP'S TARIFF WAR IS COLLAPSING IN REAL TIME</u>

China's exports surged 19.4% YoY in May, smashing the 15% Bloomberg consensus (El Economista). The number that should embarrass Washington: exports TO THE US grew 35.4% despite the tariff war supposedly designed to choke them. High-tech +51%. Integrated circuits +120%. Auto exports +73% on EV demand. Imports also up 27.4%.

The lesson for Mexico: diversification works. Beijing pivoted to Asia, Africa, Latin America for a decade and now beats US "maximum pressure" with hard data. Mexico's window to follow — EU trade deal, BRICS engagement, China rail — is open right now. The empire's economic weapon is rusting.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>ISRAEL BREAKS LEBANON CEASEFIRE AGAIN — 14 DEAD IN ONE DAY</u>

Israeli airstrikes killed at least 14 people in southern Lebanon in a single day, shredding the October 2024 ceasefire once more. Five died when an Israeli aircraft hit a vehicle parked in front of the Red Cross headquarters in Tyre. Seven killed in Zefta (Nabatieh). Two more in Marwaniya (Saida). One in Al-Jarayeb.

The "ceasefire" is fiction held together by Western press releases — Israel kills health workers, ambulances and civilians every week while the truce officially still holds. Over 3,500 Lebanese civilians killed since the October 2024 "end of war." The arms come from Washington.
